title: Petition of NSTAR Electric Company, pursuant to G.L. c. 164, § 72, for a determination that a 115 kV transmission line from Carver, Massachusetts, to Wareham, Massachusetts, is necessary and will serve the public convenience.
filings: DPU Chairman consolidates DPU 07-60 and DPU 07-61
Order of Notice and Notice of Filing and Public Hearing issued by DPU

Order of Notice. Notice of Filing and Public Hearing. Monday, September 10, 2007, at the Carver public Library, 2 Meadowbrook Way, Carver, Beginning at 7:00 p.m.. By Secretary, Mary L. Cottrell. DPU 07-60/07-61
Counsel for NSTAR files pre-filed testimony of John M. Zicko, P.E., Gregory Sullivan, James Bodkin and Colin Duncan
Presiding Officer requests company to provide a more detailed map of the transmission line route
Counsel for NSTAR files Motion for Protective Treatment of Confidential information
Counsel for NSTAR files Section 72 checklist
NSTAR Electric Company files petition for approval to construct and operate transmission lines, pursuant to G.L. c. 164, § 72
